headline: Coalition of the Willing exercise Koalicja 26.2 runs Nov 9-22
dek: [PRIMARY-SOURCE CLAIM -- Russian Foreign Ministry's own position, carried by 2 tiered families] Foreign Ministry spokesperson Maria Zakharova said European countries have no role at the negotiating table for resolving the Ukraine conflict, and that the Coalition of the Willing exercise Koalicja…
sources: Russian Foreign Ministry spokesperson Maria Zakharova, written statement via TASS
fault_line: Should Europe accept a US-Russia-Ukraine deal made without it, or is a table without Europe proof the talks are a carve-up?

sections.what_happened: [PRIMARY-SOURCE CLAIM -- Russian Foreign Ministry's own position, carried by 2 tiered families] Foreign Ministry spokesperson Maria Zakharova said European countries have no role at the negotiating table for resolving the Ukraine conflict, and that the Coalition of the Willing exercise Koalicja 26.2 (multinational-force exercises planned Nov 9-22 in Ukraine) 'once again confirms that Europeans have no place at the negotiating table'. She said Britain and France want a military foothold in Ukraine to keep confronting Russia and inflict a military defeat, and reiterated that deployment of any foreign military contingent in Ukraine is 'categorically unacceptable' and that any such unit 'will be considered a legitimate target' by the Russian Armed Forces. Context: US-Russia-Ukraine trilateral consultations resume in Abu Dhabi on Nov 10-11 (Witkoff); the multinational-force concept was announced after the Coalition of the Willing meeting in Kyiv on Aug 24, 2026.
sections.what_verified: 2 independent publisher families (TASS, Xinhua), both carrying the ministry's own statement; IANS wire as attribution-only relay (no declared tier).
sections.what_disputed: No Western official has confirmed Europe's exclusion from the Abu Dhabi table; the 'legitimate target' warning is a restated Russian position (Moscow has said this about foreign deployments since 2022), not a new operational order. The exercise itself is a Coalition of the Willing training event, not a deployment. Trump has said a peace deal could 'involve all of Europe' (Telegraph, Nov 7) -- directly at odds with Zakharova's framing.
sections.why_matters: Russia just told Europe: you don't get a seat -- and any troops you send are targets. The warning lands 48 hours before the Abu Dhabi talks.
sections.context: Background: MISSED CATCH-UP (Russian Foreign Ministry statement Sat Nov 7, via TASS; Udaya News/IANS published 2026-11-08T01:07:02Z = 05:07 ; Lao Dong 08:25+07:00 = 05:25 ; zero 'Zakharova' mentions in any Nov 7 or Nov 8 scan -- grep confirms) -- Russia says Europe has no place in Ukraine talks; any foreign troops deployed in Ukraine will be 'legitimate targets'; Coalition of the Willing exercise Koalicja 26.2 runs Nov 9-22
